title: Rust: presence domain types + CBOR codec
description: Domain types for presence with CBOR encoding
close_reason: Implemented presence domain types in lichen-client/src/presence.rs: PresenceStatus enum (available/busy/away/offline/emergency), Activity enum (stationary/moving/resting/working), Presence struct with CBOR codec (from_cbor/to_cbor), and PresenceCache for /presence/cache endpoint. Added Error::Encode variant to support encoding.
